# OG image fonts

TrueType copies of the site brand faces for Open Graph PNG rendering via `rsvg-convert`.

- **Space Grotesk** — [floriankarsten/space-grotesk](https://github.com/floriankarsten/space-grotesk) (OFL)
- **DM Sans** — [googlefonts/dm-fonts](https://github.com/googlefonts/dm-fonts) (OFL)
